Name: Castlevania Puzzle: Encore of the Night
Description: A match-three puzzle battler set in the world of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night. Play as Alucard, duel enemies and bosses by clearing blocks, explore Dracula's castle, and collect equipment and playing cards.

Achievements.Name: Apprentice Explorer
Achievements.Description: Reveal 25% of the rooms in the entire game map.

Achievements.Name: Senior Explorer
Achievements.Description: Reveal 50% of the rooms in the entire game map.

Achievements.Name: Veteran Explorer
Achievements.Description: Reveal 75% of the rooms in the entire game map.

Achievements.Name: Master Explorer
Achievements.Description: Reveal 100% of the rooms in the entire game map.

Achievements.Name: Pair
Achievements.Description: Acquire enough playing cards to achieve a poker hand pair.

Achievements.Name: Straight
Achievements.Description: Acquire enough playing cards to achieve a poker hand straight.

Achievements.Name: Flush
Achievements.Description: Acquire enough playing cards to achieve a poker hand flush.

Achievements.Name: Royal Flush
Achievements.Description: Acquire enough playing cards to achieve a poker hand royal flush.

Achievements.Name: Veteran Collector
Achievements.Description: Acquire all cards of one suit of playing cards.

Achievements.Name: Master Collector
Achievements.Description: Acquire all of the 26 playing cards.

Achievements.Name: Son of Dracula
Achievements.Description: Complete the 'Son of Dracula' Equipment set.
